mapper.sql: select l.leave_id, l.apply_user_id, l.apply_user_name, l.apply_dept_id, l.leave_type, l.start_time, l.end_time, l.duration, l.reason, l.attachment_url, l.process_instance_id, l.status, l.apply_time, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark, d.dept_name as apply_dept_name from oa_leave l left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = l.apply_dept_id
